headline: H100 SXM and H200 lead weekly gains as Hopper rental prices climb while MI300X holds flat.
bullets: H100 SXM's market index rose +23% over 7 days to $5.33, with the hyperscaler median at $10.68 versus $4.32 for neoclouds, a +147% hyperscaler premium.
H200 climbed +22% to a $6.58 market index, while RunPod Community Cloud lists it at a $3.59 median against a $10.30 hyperscaler median.
B200 gained +6% to an $8.55 market index, carrying the narrowest hyperscaler premium at +71% ($14.12 hyperscaler versus $8.25 neocloud).
MI300X was unchanged at +0% and offers the best price-performance at $2.64 per PFLOP-hour, though only 5 providers list it.
A100 80GB SXM and L40S were also flat at +0%, with A100 the costliest per unit of compute at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour.
watch: Whether the +23% H100 SXM and +22% H200 weekly gains push more demand toward MI300X, whose market index is still flat at $3.45.
